record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace dot-product compatibility with jointly trained bilinear compatibility s(h,i)=e_i^T A h, initializing A to identity. This may capture directional item-transition relationships while preserving the existing HSTU gated attention, embeddings and readout. Use the same scoring formula in training, validation and the predictor writer; checkpoint A with each category's single model. Keep features, sequence handling, loss, optimizer and hyperparameters fixed.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, learn identity-initialized bilinear compatibility e_i^T A h. Share the scoring transformation across training, validation and generated inference while preserving HSTU, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. Each category checkpoints its jointly trained compatibility matrix with its single model.
